workflow.title: Vapor Intrusion Evaluation & Investigation
workflow.description: Connecticut regulatory, investigation, criteria, technical, and analytical resources for evaluating a potential vapor intrusion pathway.

relationships.workflow_note: Use when incorporating soil vapor, indoor air, buildings, receptors, and preferential migration pathways into the Connecticut release-characterization approach and conceptual site model.
Consult the controlling Connecticut requirements governing release characterization, groundwater Volatilization Criteria, and available vapor-related compliance provisions.
Open to locate Connecticut's current Volatilization Criteria and maintained guidance connecting groundwater conditions, land use, and overlying buildings.
Review when investigation data may be relevant to an alternative Volatilization Criterion or another vapor-related compliance measure recognized by the RBCRs.
Use as the principal technical reference for developing and evaluating a vapor-intrusion conceptual site model, investigation strategy, and multiple lines of evidence.
Use when selecting applicable Connecticut analytical QA/QC materials and planning review of soil-vapor, sub-slab, or indoor-air laboratory data.
